title: Two Teams
story: A club must split its players into two teams, and some pairs of players refuse to play on the same team (a refusal goes both ways). Can every player be put on one of two teams so that no two rivals share a team? Some players have no rivals at all, and some groups of players never meet the others.

notes: Every rivalry is listed in both directions.

hints: Put one player on team 0; every rival of theirs must go on team 1, every rival of those on team 0, and so on.
Spread the teams with a breadth-first search, keeping each player's team in a list (-1 for not placed yet). Two rivals already on the same team means it cannot work.
Groups of players that never meet need their own search: start one from every player who is still unplaced.
edgeCases: a group elsewhere that cannot be split
